verdict.rationale: Community reports show Meilisearch has batch indexing that handles large imports: a 7M-article initial import, a 1,000,000-record send, and ~80M documents once batch indexing arrived. However, no first-party docs in the pack describe bulk add, update or delete endpoints, and one user reports indexing of 50k frequently changing records fell behind for hours. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of bulk/batch document operations (update, delete-by-filter, batch settings changes), and evidence of bulk operations through the AI-native/MCP interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: They needed a 16GB machine for the initial import because batch indexing is memory-intensive.
later releases plus batch indexing fixed it
